maddeler.e:
نستجم (form X)
# نَسْتَجِمُّ (nastajimmu) /nas.ta.d͡ʒim.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجَمَّ (istajamma)
# نَسْتَجِمَّ (nastajimma) /nas.ta.d͡ʒim.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجَمَّ (istajamma)
# نَسْتَجِمِّ (nastajimmi) /nas.ta.d͡ʒim.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَجَمَّ (istajamma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
